traits.name: Fiendish Restoration
traits.text: If it dies, the naga returns to life in 1d6 days and regains all its Hit Points. Only a _Wish_ spell can prevent this trait from functioning.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The naga makes three attacks, using Bite or Necrotic Ray in any combination.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: _Melee Attack Roll:_ +7, reach 10 ft. _Hit:_ 7 (1d6 + 4) Piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) Poison damage.

actions.name: Necrotic Ray
actions.text: _Ranged Attack Roll:_ +6, range 60 ft. _Hit:_ 21 (6d6) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.text:
The naga casts one of the following spells, requiring no Somatic or Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):
 **At Will:** _Detect Magic_, _Mage Hand_, _Minor Illusion_, _Water Breathing_
 **2/Day Each:** _Detect Thoughts_, _Dimension Door_, _Hold Person_ (level 3 version), _Lightning Bolt_ (level 4 version) ## Sprite
